annotations.title: Polish savings bond rate in the next interest period

description: Use for the rate of Polish savings bonds (EDO, COI, ROR, DOR, ROS, ROD) in the next interest period, for example "what will my EDO pay from December" or "what will COI pay in the next year". If the user gives the purchase month, use type and purchase_month. If the state is estimate, tell the user that it is a model estimate. If the state is unknown, give knownFrom. Finwire Bondcast (finwire_bond_next_rate): the interest rate of Polish State Treasury retail savings bonds in the next interest period, from the rules in the Ministry of Finance issue letters. COI, EDO, ROS and ROD from the 2nd year: margin + GUS CPI y/y for month M-2 (M = first month of the period), zero if CPI is negative. ROR and DOR each month: NBP reference rate on the 10th working day before the month + margin. Each period has a state: announced (Ministry of Finance interest table), known (rate from the formula with a published input), estimate (GUS flash CPI, Finwire Nowcast CPI with an 80% interval, or scenarios of the next RPP decision) or unknown (no number; knownFrom gives the date of the exact rate). Without arguments: the index (2nd year of EDO bought 12 months before next month), periods that start in the next 3 months by bond type, the formula inputs and how the Ministry of Finance followed RPP decisions. With series, or with type and purchase_month: all interest periods of that series. A series code is the type + month and year of maturity (EDO bought in December 2025 = EDO1235). Informational data, not investment advice.

purchase_month.description: Month of purchase 'YYYY-MM'. Use with type.

series.description: Series code, e.g. EDO1235, COI1129, ROR1127 (type + MMYY of maturity).

type.description: Bond type. Use with purchase_month when the user does not know the series code.
